name: State Minority Scholarship Part II (DHE)
des: The State Minority Scholarship Part II (DHE) is a Maharashtra Government scholarship scheme implemented through the Directorate of Higher Education (DHE) and MahaDBT portal. The scheme aims to support students belonging to notified minority communities pursuing higher education by providing financial assistance towards educational expenses. It is available to students from Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, and Parsi communities studying in recognized higher educational institutions in Maharashtra. The scholarship encourages continuation of education by reducing the financial burden on minority families. Benefits are disbursed through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to the student's Aadhaar-linked bank account.
benefits: Scholarship assistance provided to minority community students pursuing higher education
Financial support helps cover educational expenses during the academic year
Applicable for undergraduate and postgraduate courses in recognized institutions
Encourages continuation of higher education among minority students
Reduces financial burden on economically weaker minority families
Scholarship amount is credited directly through DBT to the student's bank account
Can be availed by eligible students studying in professional and non-professional courses
Supports students enrolled in approved higher education institutions in Maharashtra
Renewal facility available subject to satisfactory academic performance
Available through online application on the MahaDBT portal
criteria: Applicant must belong to a notified minority community (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, or Parsi)
Applicant must be a domicile/resident of Maharashtra
Student must be pursuing higher education in a recognized institution within Maharashtra
Annual family income from all sources should not exceed ₹8,00,000
Applicant must have secured at least 50% marks in the previous qualifying examination
Student must be admitted to a recognized undergraduate or postgraduate course
Applicant should not be receiving another scholarship for the same purpose from any other government department
Regular attendance and satisfactory academic progress must be maintained
Student must possess a valid Aadhaar-linked bank account for DBT benefits
All information and documents submitted must be genuine and verifiable
required_documents: Minority Community Self-Declaration or Certificate (if applicable)
Annual Family Income Certificate issued by competent authority
Fee Receipt for Current Academic Year
Undertaking/Declaration as prescribed by the scheme
application_process: Register as a new applicant using Aadhaar-linked mobile number
Login and complete the applicant profile with personal, academic, and bank details
Navigate to Directorate of Higher Education (DHE) schemes section
Select 'State Minority Scholarship Part II (DHE)' from the available schemes list
Fill in all required academic, personal, and institution details
Upload all necessary documents in the prescribed format
Verify the entered information carefully before submission
Note the Application ID for future reference and tracking
Ensure that the institution verifies and forwards the application
Track application status regularly through the MahaDBT portal
